name: Oliver Lake
blurb: Sounding-derived bathymetry from a 2003 MNRF GPS spot-depth survey (7,807 soundings inside the lake, 1-45 m; year from the LIO bathymetry index). Depths are a thin-plate-spline fit of 25 m sounding nodes, capped at 49.5 m; confidence is distance-to-nearest-sounding (100% of water cells at >=0.4); held-out cross-validation MAE 0.95 m on 207 soundings. Cold-regime lake; lake trout, cisco, walleye in the ARA community. Secchi 5.6 m (ARA).
